url.label: AudioMuse-AI URL
url.description: Base URL of AudioMuse-AI, e.g. http://audiomuse:8000

api_token.label: API token
api_token.description: The API_TOKEN configured in AudioMuse-AI (Bearer token for plugins).

prefer_over_builtin.label: Ask AudioMuse-AI first
prefer_over_builtin.description: Ask AudioMuse-AI for similar tracks before Last.fm and Sonic Similarity. If AudioMuse-AI has no answer, Music Assistant still falls back to them.

fallback_1.label: Fallback 1
fallback_1.description: Asked in this order when AudioMuse-AI has no answer (track not analyzed, index not built, server unreachable). The first source with results wins. If all are empty, Music Assistant asks its remaining providers (e.g. Last.fm) itself.

fallback_2.label: Fallback 2
fallback_2.description: Asked in this order when AudioMuse-AI has no answer (track not analyzed, index not built, server unreachable). The first source with results wins. If all are empty, Music Assistant asks its remaining providers (e.g. Last.fm) itself.

fallback_3.label: Fallback 3
fallback_3.description: Asked in this order when AudioMuse-AI has no answer (track not analyzed, index not built, server unreachable). The first source with results wins. If all are empty, Music Assistant asks its remaining providers (e.g. Last.fm) itself.

server_name.label: AudioMuse-AI music server
server_name.description: Name of the music server configured in AudioMuse-AI. Leave empty for its default server. It must be the Music Assistant server, because results are Music Assistant library ids.

eliminate_duplicates.label: Limit songs per artist
eliminate_duplicates.description: Limit how many tracks of the same artist appear in the results.

mood_similarity.label: Also match mood
mood_similarity.description: Also filter results by mood features (danceable, happy, relaxed, sad, ...).

radius_similarity.label: Smooth radio (fewer jumps)
radius_similarity.description: Order similar tracks as a smooth walk from the seed, so the radio drifts gradually instead of jumping (AudioMuse-AI radius similarity).

title_artist_fallback.label: Look up unmatched tracks by artist and title
title_artist_fallback.description: If AudioMuse-AI does not know the track (not analyzed yet, or a streaming track), ask it by artist and title instead.

clear_api_token.label: Remove the saved API token
clear_api_token.description: Tick this if AudioMuse-AI no longer requires a token.

enable_discover_row.label: Show 'Inspired by recently played' on the discover page
enable_discover_row.description: A discover row with tracks AudioMuse-AI finds similar to your recently played tracks.

enable_mood_rows.label: Show mood rows on the discover page
enable_mood_rows.description: Rows for Happy, Relaxed, Danceable, Party, Energetic and Melancholic from AudioMuse-AI's mood anchors. They start hidden; enable the ones you like on the discover page.

enable_alchemy_rows.label: Show alchemy rows on the discover page
enable_alchemy_rows.description: One row per alchemy anchor saved in AudioMuse-AI (build them in AudioMuse-AI's Alchemy page).

manifest.description: Similar tracks and radio mode from a self-hosted AudioMuse-AI sonic analysis server.

config_categories.fallback: Fallback when AudioMuse-AI has no answer
